name: Kirisaki Jirou
source: The vice-captain of Mortkranken and Yuri Isami's right-hand man. He is fearfully referred to as "Frankenstein," and rumor has it he simply woke up in a lab one day. Cool and apathetic, he has an impressive knowledge of medicine.
